docs.text: i was so busy worrying about potential flooding in the great lakes region that i forgot to be worried about potential drought in the great lakes region
June 11 drought map. Seems like farms not leveraging the Great Lakes are up shit creek. Hormuz fertilizer issues in tandem. Are we cooked?
Great lakes need water! That's sad to hear, any of the years I was there I never really remembered a drought. Weird times
Im assuming the Great Lakes in general are keeping a drought at bay for most of the real Midwest and lake-adjacent areas of the Northeast

Oh good, it's raining AGAIN. Normally I am vehemently against any plundering of the Great Lakes, but with the rest of the US in drought conditions, I'm willing to talk about it...while we are still above water, barely.

Dammit Robert, i’ve been a Californian/Oregonian for most of my life, and now I’m in the (nonspecific ) Midwest, and the best thing about it that I can finally let go of some of my drought fears. And that is entirely because of the Great Lakes! No power for you 😆
You take the good with the bad being down wind from the Great Lakes... The good news is that drought is incredibly unlikely...silver lining🥰

I honestly don't know what to tell you. Every site >100 km away from another has different marker years that tend not to match up well against supposed regional drought reconstructions. It seems like storm tracks/Great Lakes rarely make for regionally coherent drought across this region.

Chautauqua County Now Under Drought Warning Chautauqua County has joined nine other counties in the Great Lakes region in being upgraded to a drought warning. New York State is encouraging all residents, including those dependent on private groundwater wells, to conserve water whenever possible…
An observation which probably doesn’t apply to the counties south of Lake Ontario and east of Lake Erie. We have had “droughts”.
